purpose: Candidate remaining execution parameters required before a later protocol/environment freeze proposal. This file is not itself a freeze.

rationale: Study 7E evaluates trust/evidence semantics, not real-time transport latency.
A zero-age threshold makes nominal evidence current and F5/F6 exactly one logical tick stale, avoiding an arbitrary physical-time constant.
The choice is an experimental semantic threshold, not an operational spacecraft timing recommendation.

evidence_epoch.scope: one immutable Study-7E protocol/environment/key-registry candidate epoch
evidence_epoch.change_rule: If the signed-evidence schema, public-key registry, or frozen execution contract changes before canonical execution, create a new epoch/freeze candidate rather than mutating epoch 1 in place.
rationale: Scenario identity is already bound by signed opaque scenario_id.
A single epoch avoids encoding block/topology/fault information.
F9 byte-47 XOR 0x01 changes epoch 1 to 0 while preserving structural length and invalidating both signature and epoch validity.

opaque_registry_algorithm.retry_rule: Process labels in lexicographic order within each namespace; retry with incremented integer if candidate is zero or already used in that namespace.
opaque_registry_algorithm.policy_visibility: scenario/source/key/authority numeric IDs are parsed metadata; topology/fault labels and registry alias maps remain research-only

deterministic_test_keys.security_interpretation: These are reproducible non-secret cryptographic test fixtures. F3/F4 model granted signing capability for the affected key domain; they do not measure real-world secret-key discovery or entropy resistance.

proposed_finalization: F1/F2 source-stage false authorization then legitimate signing
F3/F4 false current-context body signed with affected test key
F5/F6 exact signed body evaluated one logical tick after nominal under max_age=0
F9 post-signature XOR 0x01 at signed-body byte 47
F10 false authority output before source stage/signing
F11 F10 followed by F9 in fixed stage order
F12 two separately signed same-sequence opposite-authorization bodies

reasons: Every value is deterministic and reproducible from versioned design inputs.
No proposed registry numeric value encodes topology or fault labels directly.
Zero-tick freshness avoids adding a physical-latency confound absent from the research question.
A constant epoch avoids scenario/block leakage and gives F9 a deterministic epoch-invalid mutation.
Host-only deterministic test keys maximize reproducibility while preserving the already-approved no-private-key-in-cFS boundary.
The current F0-F12 transformations already passed host contract tests and producer/qualifier runtime tests.
adversarial_notes: 32-bit opaque IDs require mandatory collision detection; truncation alone is insufficient.
Publicly derivable test keys must never be represented as operationally secret or suitable for deployment.
Changing manifest labels, signed schema, key registry, or transform semantics after freeze requires a new freeze candidate/epoch.
Freshness max_age=0 is a controlled experimental semantic and must not be generalized to operational latency requirements.

requested_author_decisions: EP-1 approve scenario-local logical ticks with freshness_max_age_ticks=0
EP-2 approve constant evidence_epoch=1 for the freeze candidate
EP-3 approve SHA-256-derived opaque u32 registries with collision/retry guard
EP-4 approve deterministic non-secret host-only Ed25519 test-fixture derivation with no persistent private-key files
EP-5 approve current F0-F12 transforms as the final byte/stage-transform freeze candidate
